about_the_game:
It’s up to YOU to keep the wilderness clean! As the newest Park Ranger recruit, hike the trails around your new home of Townsend with your dog Chick. Check the notice board for Help Requests and clean up trash along the way. Discover unique locations and rare items hidden in the forest off the main trails. Prove yourself as the ultimate friend of the forest! 

  • Practice the buddy system! You’re never alone with Chick at your side! Hike the local trails as you work together to wrangle refuse with your four-legged friend. 

  • Do your part! Help your fellow park rangers with special clean-up requests and respond to litter reports from your neighbors!

  • Discover the wonders of nature! Explore 4 ecologically diverse locations. Feel the forest come alive as the local wildlife returns and discover unique sites hidden off the beaten path.

  • Finders keepers! Check the notice board before each adventure to see what your neighbors have been up to and get clues about rare items to collect.

There’s more than trash in these woods! So hop in the truck with Chick and Pack It Out!
